otherTracksConsidered.why: Complete round trip from the Hoh trailhead, but via Mercury and the north-east glacier then north ridge, not the Glacier Pass snow finger or col ridge our route describes.

facts.text: By mid-August the lower snow on the north-east side is bare blue ice, needing crampons and an axe before the snow turns softer higher up.

notes: All recordings take a line from Mercury and the north-east glacier, which differs from the route text (Glacier Pass snow finger). Peakbagger flagged our summit pin as suspect but it is 0 m from the surveyed point.
